headline: Tombstones Climb to No. 1 as Razerbacks and Barracudas Heat Up
lede: I'm told the Tombstones have vaulted all the way to the top of The Pecking Order, jumping 11 spots after posting the highest score in the league this week. Boom. League sources tell me this is a team that's been waiting for its moment, and a 4-2 mark over the last three weeks shows it's no fluke.

rankings.blurb: Tombstones jump 11 spots to No. 1 with a 77.8% all-play mark and a 2-game winning streak, and they just dropped 220.54 points, the highest score in the league this week.

Razerbacks hold steady at No. 2 with a 77.0% all-play mark and a 10-game winning streak, going 6-0 over the last three weeks. Money is nice, but championships are better, and this team looks built for both.
Barracudas surge 10 spots to No. 3 on a 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak, averaging 173.6 points over that span.
Kraken climb to No. 4 with a 6-0 record over the last three weeks and an 8-game winning streak, averaging 180.6 PPG over that stretch. Scary team to face right now.
Demons slip three spots to No. 5 despite a 72.6% all-play mark and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks. Still a 5-game winning streak, so this slide is about the competition, not the roster.
Chickens fall five spots to No. 6 after holding the No. 1 spot, but an 11-game winning streak and a 6-0 run over the last three weeks says this team is far from finished.
Monkeys rocket up 12 spots to No. 7 with a 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 7-game winning streak. They face the No. 3 Barracudas next week, and that's a huge test.
Yeti's drop two spots to No. 8 with a 69.8% all-play mark, though a 4-2 record over the last three weeks shows they're still dangerous.
Hurricanes tumble six spots to No. 9 despite a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks and a 65.2% all-play mark. Sources say they need to find a rhythm fast.
RailRoaders climb four spots to No. 10 on a 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak, though their 149.8 PPG over that span is worth watching.
Cellmates fall seven spots to No. 11 after a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks, with a 67.6% all-play mark keeping them in the top 12.
Nemesis surge nine spots to No. 12 with a 3-game winning streak and a 4-2 record over the last three weeks. Boom, this team is coming alive.
Monsters slip three spots to No. 13 after going 2-4 over the last three weeks, though their 71.4% all-play mark shows the talent is still there.
Chargers rocket up 12 spots to No. 14 on a 2-game winning streak and a 4-2 record over the last three weeks, averaging 164.4 PPG over that span.
SnakeEyes slide seven spots to No. 15 with a 3-game losing streak and a 2-4 record over the last three weeks. League sources tell me they need to stop the bleeding.
Spiders climb seven spots to No. 16 with a 4-2 record over the last three weeks and a 61.2% all-play mark, quietly building momentum.
Hoosiers slip two spots to No. 17 despite a 5-game winning streak and a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks. Still a top-20 team on paper.
Dawgs jump 23 spots to No. 18 after a huge climb, though a 2-4 record over the last three weeks means the work isn't done.
Badgers fall 10 spots to No. 19 with a 3-game losing streak and a 3-3 mark over the last three weeks, averaging 139.9 PPG over that span.
Sandmen rocket up 19 spots to No. 20 on a 2-game winning streak and a 4-2 record over the last three weeks. Huge move for this team.
Mafia surge 22 spots to No. 21 with a 6-game winning streak and a 6-0 run over the last three weeks. Sources say this is one of the hottest teams in the league right now.
Bombers climb five spots to No. 22 with a 2-game winning streak, though a 3-3 record over the last three weeks keeps them in the middle of the pack.
Beasts surge 11 spots to No. 23 on a 6-0 run over the last three weeks and a 6-game winning streak, averaging 161.9 PPG over that span.
Freeze rocket up 28 spots to No. 24, the biggest climb in the top 25, with a 5-1 mark over the last three weeks. Money is nice, but this is a massive turnaround.
Invaders climb seven spots to No. 25 despite a 2-game losing streak and a 3-3 mark over the last three weeks. They're still in the top 25 and still dangerous.

statOfWeek.title: Stat of the Week
statOfWeek.blurb: Tombstones dropped 220.54 points this week, the highest score in the league. Boom, that's a monster week.

benchBlunder.title: Bench Blunder of the Week
benchBlunder.blurb: SaltyDogs left 69.35 points on the bench, scoring 123.77 when they could have had 193.12. League sources tell me that's a painful lesson in lineup management.

heaterOfWeek.title: Heater of the Week
heaterOfWeek.blurb: Chickens have won 11 straight, the longest active win streak in the league. Championships are better than money, and this team is chasing one.

coolerOfWeek.title: Cooler of the Week
coolerOfWeek.blurb: Roughnecks have dropped 10 in a row, the longest active losing streak in the league. I'm told they're searching for answers.

matchupOfWeek.title: Matchup of the Week
matchupOfWeek.blurb: Week 8 features the No. 3 Barracudas at the No. 7 Monkeys, the highest-ranked clash on the slate. This one is must-watch.
